scope: Application-only synthetic workflow proof; disabled outside OM_INTEGRATION_TEST=true.
limitations: Review queue work deliberately leaves WAIT_FOR_SIGNAL paused. No canonical proposal disposal or human approval is claimed.
No production LLM execution, durable outbox, or automatic recovery scheduler is implemented.

Receipt operation identity and latest wait status protect tested deliveries, but do not bind callbacks to the original StepInstance attempt. Native rerun-step retains workflow context and re-enters executeStep without the incoming dispatch transition. Production use requires attempt binding or an application route guard before enabling reruns.
The queue-outage regression covers bounded observed failure handling; it does not establish every core rollback or restart scenario.

appOnlyRerunGuardSeam.futureImplementation: Application wrapper authenticates, resolves organization scope, loads the scoped workflow, rejects rerun for owned workflow IDs, and delegates ordinary workflows to the original route with metadata preserved.
appOnlyRerunGuardSeam.notAvailable: There is no rerun command; the custom route does not invoke before API interceptors.
